blocks.text:
The Kachi Lodge group programme continues: 3 days / 2 nights with full board.

The route passes colourful lagoons, geysers, volcanoes and dry high-altitude plateaus. Flamingos, vicuñas and various bird species can be seen here.

After lunch, which is included in the programme, you will head to Colchani. Here, salt extraction has become part of the local craft tradition.

The route then heads out onto the salt flats. Stops are planned at the Salt Hotel-Museum, the first of its kind on the route, and at Ojos de Agua, or “Eyes of Water”, small salt springs that reveal processes involved in the formation of the salt flats.

By midday, you will reach Incahuasi Island in the centre of Uyuni. The island has limestone rock formations, large cacti and local wildlife. Its upper slopes offer panoramic views in every direction across the salt flats.
